title: Demystifying Hateful Content: Leveraging Large Multimodal Models for Hateful Meme Detection with Explainable Decisions
measurement_description: The paper evaluates Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) on their ability to detect and explain hateful memes. While the study does not focus exclusively on religion, it evaluates the models using datasets (such as FHM-FG) that specifically categorize and include memes inciting religious-based hatred alongside other forms of hate.
findings: The paper does not report isolated findings for the religious category alone. Overall, the authors found that their proposed IntMeme framework, which leverages LMMs (like mPLUG-Owl and InstructBLIP) to generate natural language meme interpretations prior to classification, significantly outperformed state-of-the-art baselines on datasets containing hate speech, including religious hate.
